intent.note: Description: 'Fix the low review findings ... For each finding either fix it ... or ... say so with the evidence ... The outcome answers every listed finding by id, one line each ... Edit only the declared files; a fix that needs another file is reported, not made. No F/P/BUG ids in code, comments or docstrings. No number written into prose.' The outcome answers all twelve ids, one line each, as fixed or no-change. I read each rewritten sentence against the tree and each holds. LINTS_DIR is at _output.py:102. The --task text matches audit-status.py:1984-1995, _status_facts.gate_exemptions (the task plus its non-terminal phase siblings, high bugs only, env var absent) and run-test-gate.with_gate_task. v3.6.0 holds the --task flag and the GATE TASK lines but no changelog line for them. The _slashed docstring matches the relpath/ValueError code. The orchestrator.md and guide reviewer-session text matches reviewer_dispatch, REVIEWER_SESSION_RULE, reviewer_session_step, writer_said (the run: line) and MAX_RESUME_ROUNDS. The clauses-uncovered and red-refused text matches writer_path_on in red_refused and clauses_uncovered. The red-first obligation text matches _filed_returns.owes_red_first and drive-phase submit (the not-attempted block for a tdd task with expectRedFirst false). The _worktrees reason matches remove_task_tree and its three callers: retire_member, retire_asides and the recut. The run-agent-session guide paragraph matches the module docstring and _parent_tmp, drop_session_tmp and _run's finally. No-change claims hold: CLAUDE.md names plugins/audit/tests/ once, at line 333, as the retired directory, and has LINTS_DIR at line 42; tools/lints/_deps.py rows for tree_changed and _changed_between already say the paths are narrowed in Python and never handed back to git; commands/phase.md step 3 already says a run: line. The five usage lines and the phase-signoff clause are gone, and the changes carry no finding ids or new counts. No sentence is false. Three findings stay partly open, all named by the executor as outside the declared files: P131-R5 (three comments), P142-R44 (ts2 title), plus the new over-wide CHANGELOG line. The filed outcome describes the diff. One thing its gate line leaves out: the five-suite gate does not exercise the agent and command documents beyond ih5 and the byte ceiling, which measure-context covers.
